record_title: Spectral-persistence counterexamples and a repair for AdOGD
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The exact Theorem 8 failures use endpoint-reciprocal initial seed steps and address the current arXiv v1 of the source paper. Nearby seeds can shadow the exceptional trajectory for arbitrarily long finite horizons, but generic seeds are not claimed to fail asymptotically. The repaired theorem is quadratic-specific. A distinct theorem-level final IFAC proceedings version was not located in searchable full text.
